help:
Build and deploy Kata reference architectures

Usage: krab [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  edit         Edit an existing configuration using its current settings as defaults
  init         Create a configuration through interactive setup
  list         Discover pinned choices; JSON retains complete catalog metadata
  validate     Validate a configuration and its generated Helm values offline
  generate     Generate chart-versioned Helm values; stdout by default
  install      Show a Helm deployment plan; --execute applies it to the named context
  precheck     Run local host probes or remote node pre-checks; use 'precheck --help' for options
  conformance  Evaluate cluster host prerequisites; use 'conformance --help' for options
  completions  Generate shell completions
  help         Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --profile <PROFILE>  Apply a product profile to available choices, defaults, and advanced features
  -h, --help               Print help
  -V, --version            Print version

commands.help:
Edit an existing configuration using its current settings as defaults

commands.name: precheck
commands.about: Run local host probes or remote node pre-checks; use 'precheck --help' for options
commands.help:
Remote node: krab precheck --node NODE [--context NAME] [--kubeconfig FILE] [--output FILE]
Remote scope: krab precheck --run [--node-selector SELECTOR] [--context NAME]
Remote runs require Helm and kubectl, install the pre-check chart, and emit JSON evidence.

Usage: krab conformance --help
or: krab precheck --node-report
or: krab precheck [--json] [--kvm] [--tdx] [--snp] [--ibm-se] [--iommufd] [--erofs] [--gpu] [--gpu-cc] [--gpu-ppcie]
Select one or more host checks. They do not launch a VM or test a VFIO device.
--kvm       /dev/kvm exists as a character device
--tdx       /sys/module/kvm_intel/parameters/tdx is enabled
--snp       /sys/module/kvm_amd/parameters/sev_snp is enabled
--ibm-se    /sys/firmware/uv/prot_virt_host is enabled
--iommufd   /dev/iommu readiness and running-kernel module support
--erofs     mkfs.erofs contains the mkfs-time and sort options
--gpu       kata-device-provisioner finds a supported NVIDIA GPU
--gpu-cc    A supported NVIDIA GPU is CC capable
--gpu-ppcie A supported NVIDIA GPU is PPCIE capable
--json      Write one JSON object to stdout
--node-report  Write a complete KRAB node report
--cache-dir DIR  Store results in DIR (default: $XDG_CACHE_HOME/krab/preflight or $HOME/.cache/krab/preflight)
--force-refresh  Repeat checks and replace the cached result
--no-cache     Run checks without reading or writing cached results
--help      Show this help

commands.name: conformance
commands.about: Evaluate cluster host prerequisites; use 'conformance --help' for options
commands.help:
Usage: krab conformance [--require REQUIREMENT ...] [--require-any gpu-cc,gpu-ppcie]
  (--report FILE | --run | --local) [--json] [--output FILE]
  or: krab conformance install --help
  or: krab conformance remove --help

Requirements: kvm (basic virtualization), cc (any supported CPU TEE), tdx, snp, se, gpu-cc, gpu-ppcie, erofs.
Choose one CPU requirement and/or GPU requirements. Every node must pass all
selected requirements and KVM. Require erofs only for runtime classes that need it.
Unknown/review on required checks means fail.
--require-any LIST  Allow either GPU capability on each node: gpu-cc,gpu-ppcie
--gpu-model MODEL   Require a matching GPU model (repeat for alternatives)
--report FILE       Evaluate a v2 cluster pre-check report; '-' reads stdin
--nodes FILE        Also verify coverage against kubectl get nodes -o json
--run               Run fresh pre-flight probes through Helm, then evaluate
--local             Collect and evaluate this host directly, without cache or Kubernetes
--daemon            Keep running local checks under a host service manager
--interval-seconds N  Cadence of daemon checks (default: 60)
--timeout-seconds N   Bound each daemon check (default: 30)
--integrity-manifest FILE  Verify the checker before each daemon check
--nfd-output FILE   Atomically publish an expiring NFD feature file (requires --local)
--result-ttl-seconds N  Lifetime of local NFD evidence (default: 180, maximum: 86400)
--node-selector S   Restrict --run to matching Linux nodes (default: all Linux nodes)
--chart PATH_OR_OCI  Pre-check chart (default: oci://ghcr.io/kata-containers/krab-precheck)
--version VERSION   Chart version (default: this binary's version)
--namespace NAME    Pre-check namespace (default: krab-conformance)
--release NAME      Pre-check release (default: krab-conformance)
--kubeconfig FILE   Kubeconfig file (default: KUBECONFIG or ~/.kube/config)
--context NAME      Kubernetes context (default: current context, pinned for the run)
--output FILE       Save the JSON verdict, node inventory, and pre-check evidence
--failed-nodes      Show only failed/error nodes and their reasons in text output
--json              Write the JSON verdict to stdout instead of text
--termination-message FILE  Write a compact status summary for a Kubernetes container

Exit codes: 0 all nodes pass; 1 complete checks show nonconformance; 2 collection/evidence/CLI/output error.
This verifies reported host prerequisites; it does not launch confidential workloads or attest them.
